|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “During a battle at a site with R2-D2, may not be targeted by weapons and may draw one destiny, subtracting that amount from opponent's total power. Once per game, may place all your Effects that are not [Immune to Alter] in your Used Pile.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[C-3PO (See-Threepio) (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “During battle at a site with R2-D2, may not be targeted by weapons, and may draw one destiny; subtract that amount from opponent’s total power. Once per game, may place all your non-[Immune to Alter] Effects on table in Used Pile.” '''What changed:''' removed “a”; “weapons” → “weapons,”; “destiny, subtracting” → “destiny; subtract”; “opponent's” → “opponent’s”; “Effects that are not [Immune” → “non-[Immune”; added “Effects on table”; removed “your”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=1 VirtualCards2.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown); page 1, slip 3. Slip image and game text from this sheet. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192928/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards2.pdf Internet Archive primary-source copy].
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[C-3PO (See-Threepio)]].
* Later text: [[C-3PO (See-Threepio) (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[C-3PO (See-Threepio) (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[C-3PO (See-Threepio)]].
